parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. If you set this parameter to true, the system performs the same synchronous admission checks as a real deletion, but does not create a deletion run or idempotent record, stop the service, or delete the API or associated configurations. If you set this parameter to false or leave it empty, the actual deletion is accepted
parameters.help_zh: 是否只做预检。true时执行与真实删除一致的同步准入校验，但不创建删除运行或幂等记录，不停止服务、不删除API或关联配置；false或缺省时受理实际删除
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The idempotent request token. For the same tenant, model API, and parameters, you can use the original client token to retry the deletion if a background deletion fails. A conflict is returned if an active operation is in progress or if the configuration has been replaced by a newer operation. A replay of a fully completed deletion returns an empty success response, but using the same token for a different target is still rejected
parameters.help_zh: 幂等请求标识。同一租户、模型API和参数使用原clientToken可在后台删除失败后续删；仍有活动操作或配置已被较新操作替换时返回冲突。已完整删除的重放保持空成功，同token换目标仍拒绝
parameters.name: client_token

requestId.description_en: The request ID generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
